title: House Robber
statement:
Use dynamic programming to maximize the sum of chosen positions with no adjacent choices. Solve for both a line and a cycle.

Input
n, then n signed values. For the cycle, positions 1 and n are adjacent when n≥2. Empty selection is allowed.

Output
Print the line optimum followed by the cycle optimum.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Each value has absolute value at most 10⁹.
